meta.name: dev-trace
meta.description: Evidence-driven causal tracing with competing hypotheses. Use when an observation has multiple plausible explanations and you need to systematically rank them with evidence FOR and AGAINST each. Pairs with @trail-tracer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用证据和假设系统排查问题根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果面对复杂问题需要结构化推理和证据排序
copy.tagline_en: Systematically trace root causes with evidence and hypotheses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured reasoning and evidence ranking for complex issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会系统性地列出多个可能原因，为每个收集支持和反对的证据，按证据强度排序，最终给出最可能的解释及下一步验证实验。
howto.when: 当面对一个观察结果有多个合理解释，且不想仓促下结论时触发，例如间歇性bug、区域异常或性能问题。

say.text: 为什么这个功能在区域A失败而在区域B正常？帮我追踪原因。
say.note: Claude会启动多假设因果追踪。

say.text: 服务器间歇性超时，列出所有可能原因并评估证据。
用户报告数据不一致，分析可能原因并设计验证实验。
say.note: Claude会生成假设并推荐下一步。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically generates multiple competing explanations for an observation, collects evidence FOR and AGAINST each, ranks them by strength, and concludes with the best explanation and a discriminating probe.
howto.when_en: Use when an observation has multiple plausible explanations and you need to systematically rank them with evidence FOR and AGAINST each. Typical for intermittent bugs, regional anomalies, or performance puzzles.

say_en.text: Why does feature work in region A but fail in region B? Trace the causes.
Server times out intermittently. List all plausible causes and evaluate evidence.
say_en.note: Claude gathers evidence and ranks hypotheses.

say_en.text: User reports data inconsistency. Analyze possible reasons and design experiments.
say_en.note: Claude generates hypotheses and suggests next steps.
